# 25 Must-Have Travel Accessories in India in 2026

[6 Comments](https://trywanderingmore.com/best-travel-accessories-in-india/#comments)

\| By [Trisha and Modi](https://trywanderingmore.com/author/trishamodi560/ "View all posts by Trisha and Modi")

\| 14 minutes of reading

[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Ftrywanderingmore.com%2Fbest-travel-accessories-in-india%2F)[Twitter](https://x.com/share?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftrywanderingmore.com%2Fbest-travel-accessories-in-india%2F&text=25%20Must-Have%20Travel%20Accessories%20in%20India%20in%202026&hashtags=Travel%20Tips)[Pinterest](https://pinterest.com/pin/create/bookmarklet/?media=https://trywanderingmore.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/travel-products-1-of-1.jpg&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftrywanderingmore.com%2Fbest-travel-accessories-in-india%2F&description=25%20Must-Have%20Travel%20Accessories%20in%20India%20in%202026)[Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?mini=true&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftrywanderingmore.com%2Fbest-travel-accessories-in-india%2F&title=25+Must-Have+Travel+Accessories+in+India+in+2026&source=Try+Wandering+More)[WhatsApp](https://wa.me/?text=https%3A%2F%2Ftrywanderingmore.com%2Fbest-travel-accessories-in-india%2F)

The travel accessories market in India is still in a very nascent stage. We usually search the internet thoroughly for multi-functional or utility-driven travel products and end up on US web stores. It is quite frustrating. However, we have been noticing that some such travel products are slowly becoming available online in India. We are so excited to share some must-have travel products and some unique travel accessories with you that might just be exactly what you were looking for, help reduce single-use plastic waste or make your travels more comfortable.

## 1\. Foldable Travel Pillow

[Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow - Doctor Recommended Neck Pillow - Memory Foam Airplane Pillow - Neck Pillow with Attachment Straps, Support for Car, Home, Office, and Gaming Cardinal Red](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B079X5XWXP?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow - Doctor Recommended Neck Pillow - Memory Foam Airplane Pillow - Neck Pillow with Attachment Straps, Support for Car, Home, Office, and Gaming Cardinal Red")![Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow - Doctor Recommended Neck Pillow - Memory Foam Airplane Pillow - Neck Pillow with Attachment Straps, Support for Car, Home, Office, and Gaming Cardinal Red](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/4125+T6gdwL._SL160_.jpg)

[Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow – Doctor Recommended Neck Pillow – Memory Foam Airplane Pillow – Neck Pillow with Attachment Straps, Support for Car, Home, Office, and Gaming Cardinal Red](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B079X5XWXP?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Cabeau Evolution S3 Travel Pillow - Doctor Recommended Neck Pillow - Memory Foam Airplane Pillow - Neck Pillow with Attachment Straps, Support for Car, Home, Office, and Gaming Cardinal Red")

The issue with travel pillows is that they can be really bulky. The inflatable ones save space but are uncomfortable. So, try a cloth one or a foldable one. By a cloth one, I mean a travel pillow that isn’t bulky like a typical pillow but has structural support within. We use the **[TRTL pillow](https://amzn.to/2RwVXQu)** but it is not available in India. We got the [**Cabeau Evolution Travel Neck Pillow**](https://amzn.to/34ZICDG) too recently and are pretty surprised by its comfort. It can be strapped to your flight seat too! When not in use, fold it into the provided cover and strap it to a bag. However, it is a tad bit expensive (we got ours for less than half the price on CRED), so here is a [**budget-friendly option**](https://amzn.to/3crNRQy).

[**Buy the** **Cabeau Evolution Travel Neck Pillow**](https://amzn.to/34ZICDG)

## 2\. Travel Blanket cum Cushion

[Cabeau Fold ‘n Go Travel and Throw Blanket Plus Compact Case - for Home and Travel - Doubles as Lumbar Pillow and Neck Support Pillow - French Microfiber Comfort - Blue](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B00LWAC1UE?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Cabeau Fold ‘n Go Travel and Throw Blanket Plus Compact Case - for Home and Travel - Doubles as Lumbar Pillow and Neck Support Pillow - French Microfiber Comfort - Blue")![Cabeau Fold ‘n Go Travel and Throw Blanket Plus Compact Case - for Home and Travel - Doubles as Lumbar Pillow and Neck Support Pillow - French Microfiber Comfort - Blue](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/414nQTqAOsL._SL160_.jpg)

[Cabeau Fold ‘n Go Travel and Throw Blanket Plus Compact Case – for Home and Travel – Doubles as Lumbar Pillow and Neck Support Pillow – French Microfiber Comfort – Blue](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B00LWAC1UE?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Cabeau Fold ‘n Go Travel and Throw Blanket Plus Compact Case - for Home and Travel - Doubles as Lumbar Pillow and Neck Support Pillow - French Microfiber Comfort - Blue")

[**Cabeau Microfibre Fold ‘n Go Travel Blanket**](https://amzn.to/3vlHFQN) is again a super cool travel accessory in India that serves a dual purpose. It comes folded and packed in a soft fleece case that can be used as a pillow, cushion or lumbar support. Unpacking the cover reveals a soft blanket. After using the banket, just fold it, put it inside the cover and keep it in your bag. The bag doesn’t have space? No problem. Strap it to the outside of your bag instead.

**[Buy the Cabeau Microfibre Fold ‘n Go Travel Blanket](https://amzn.to/34Xc4dt)**

## 3\. Foldable Water Bottle

![collapsible bottles to get while planning a trip to new zealand - best travel accessories in india](https://trywanderingmore.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/IMG-20191225-WA0036_Original.jpg)This bottle folds tiny and weighs nothing when not in use

Foldable water bottles are amazing because they become so compact whenever not filled up, plus they weigh next to nothing. We use this [**Platypus Collapsible Softbottle**](https://amzn.to/2Rx2pqG) purchased from the USA and found a very similar one, **[the Vapur Bottle](https://amzn.to/3iKv3Qx)**, that delivers in India. I can’t find cheaper options to recommend but you could have a look at these [**foldable bottles on Amazon**](https://amzn.to/34Y0DBY) and see if you like any.

[**Buy the Vapur Collapsible Bottle**](https://amzn.to/3iKv3Qx)

## 4\. Filter Water Bottle

[LifeStraw Go 2 Stage Tritan Water Bottle With Carbon Integrated Filter Straw For Daily Use, Travel, Camping & Outdoor Activity (Pack Of 1) - 0.65 L](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B07YT5NKVH?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "LifeStraw Go 2 Stage Tritan Water Bottle With Carbon Integrated Filter Straw For Daily Use, Travel, Camping & Outdoor Activity (Pack Of 1) - 0.65 L") ![LifeStraw Go 2 Stage Tritan Water Bottle With Carbon Integrated Filter Straw For Daily Use, Travel, Camping & Outdoor Activity (Pack Of 1) - 0.65 L](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/31Pvqu8wbLL._SL160_.jpg)7%

[LifeStraw Go 2 Stage Tritan Water Bottle With Carbon Integrated Filter Straw For Daily Use, Travel, Camping & Outdoor Activity (Pack Of 1) – 0.65 L](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B07YT5NKVH?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "LifeStraw Go 2 Stage Tritan Water Bottle With Carbon Integrated Filter Straw For Daily Use, Travel, Camping & Outdoor Activity (Pack Of 1) - 0.65 L")

₹3,490.00

Honestly, we had been eyeing this for a while and are so happy this unique travel accessory is finally available in India. If you’re travelling to a country where drinking tap water is unsafe or you’re going camping, the [**Lifestraw Bottles and Straws**](https://amzn.to/3A3tOq0) will be a lifesaver. It’ll help cut down on the monetary and environmental cost of buying bottled water at your destination and make access to drinking water during camping that much easier.

[**Buy the Lifestraw Go Personal Water Purifier Bottle**](https://amzn.to/3A3tOq0)

## 5\. Portable Cutlery

[Bridge2shopping 3 in1 Function Eating Utensil Stainless Steel Multi-Tool Camping Folding Pocket Knife, Fork Spoon Set](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0713W3GT9?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Bridge2shopping 3 in1 Function Eating Utensil Stainless Steel Multi-Tool Camping Folding Pocket Knife, Fork Spoon Set") ![Bridge2shopping 3 in1 Function Eating Utensil Stainless Steel Multi-Tool Camping Folding Pocket Knife, Fork Spoon Set](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/41ldaQSjq-L._SL160_.jpg)57%

[Bridge2shopping 3 in1 Function Eating Utensil Stainless Steel Multi-Tool Camping Folding Pocket Knife, Fork Spoon Set](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0713W3GT9?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Bridge2shopping 3 in1 Function Eating Utensil Stainless Steel Multi-Tool Camping Folding Pocket Knife, Fork Spoon Set")

₹699.00

Back to the impact of using single-use plastic. Don’t! It’s bad for the environment. Carry your own cutlery in your day bag. Whenever you’re being served food with plastic cutlery, ask them not to give it to you. Instead, use your own. Your travel cutlery will also be super useful on road trips, picnics, train journies, camping, etc.

We currently have the first one – a **[3 in 1 tool](https://amzn.to/3w7TTOb)** with a spoon, fork and knife that can be separated and used in one go. It comes in a cloth pouch. We like the second one- [**the pocket utensil set**](https://amzn.to/3x8oScL) – because it’s compact and comes in a washable box. The third one by [**Rusabl**](https://amzn.to/3q7vxSx) also has a straw which comes very handy while travelling! We use the [**Rusabl Straws**](https://amzn.to/3vrvkdV) every day at home and highly recommend them.

[**Buy the 3 in 1 Tool**](https://amzn.to/3w7TTOb) \| [**Buy the Pocket Utensil Set**](https://amzn.to/3x8oScL)

## 6\. Eye mask and Ear Plugs

[Ross 100% Mulberry Silk Sleep Mask Eye Mask, Super Smooth for Blind Fold (Blue)](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B09K5CBQ3Y?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Ross 100% Mulberry Silk Sleep Mask Eye Mask, Super Smooth for Blind Fold (Blue)") ![Ross 100% Mulberry Silk Sleep Mask Eye Mask, Super Smooth for Blind Fold (Blue)](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/41U4KK1qF0L._SL160_.jpg)60%

[Ross 100% Mulberry Silk Sleep Mask Eye Mask, Super Smooth for Blind Fold (Blue)](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B09K5CBQ3Y?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Ross 100% Mulberry Silk Sleep Mask Eye Mask, Super Smooth for Blind Fold (Blue)")

₹449.00

Okay, by now, you must have realised that we love Cabeau. The reason being – they know what they’re doing! All their products are specially designed for travel, super comfortable, and adjustable. The [**Cabeau Midnight Magic Adjustable Sleep Mask**](https://amzn.to/3v7pPki) can be adjusted to fit your face properly, relieves pressure against eyelids, prevents make-up smudges and comes with earplugs that have their own stow slot. No more losing earplugs.

A cheaper option is the [**Travel360 Degree Mulberry Silk Eye Mask**](https://amzn.to/3v99bR8) and these [**reusable earplugs**](https://amzn.to/3pzDG1A). You’ll get plenty of disposable earplugs too, but it’s just better to use reusable items and help reduce waste.

[**Buy the Cabeau Sleep Mask with Earplugs**](https://amzn.to/3v7pPki)

[**Foldable Backpacks**](https://amzn.to/357aBkQ) are great because they can be used as a day bag, beach bag, shopping bag, snack bag or a just-in-case bag while travelling. We never travel without one or sometimes even two, the second one being a tote or duffel!

They also help compress clothes to fit more! Read our post on [**travel packing tips**](https://trywanderingmore.com/super-effective-travel-packing-tips-for-your-next-vacation/) for packing hacks and to learn how to pack in cubes.

## 9\. Apple Airtag

[New Apple AirTag](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0935DN1BN?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "New Apple AirTag") ![New Apple AirTag](https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/31WbF2XSZFS._SL160_.jpg)17%

[New Apple AirTag](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B0935DN1BN?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "New Apple AirTag")

₹3,490.00

Scared about losing your check-in luggage? Or are you worried about the theft of your day bag while exploring? Don’t worry, **[the Apple AirTag](https://amzn.to/3xad5Ld)** has got you. You can use the Find My Phone App to locate your items provided they have the Airtag inside them or attached to them. When not travelling, use the Airtag as a **[keychain](https://www.amazon.in/Riggear-Premium-Leather-Holder-Compatible/dp/B09472BQ7D/ref=sr_1_4?crid=16Z2SIKJBV9UU&dchild=1&keywords=apple+airtag+keychain&qid=1623396759&refinements=p_72%3A1318476031&rnid=1318475031&sprefix=apple+airtag%2Caps%2C310&sr=8-4)** so you never lose your keys (the Airtag can make a sound by clicking a button in your Find My Phone App). The applications are limitless. The **[pack of four](https://amzn.to/3xad5Ld)** comes out to be cheaper compared to getting just one and can be used inside all your bags when travelling, for peace of mind.

There are two points to note:

1\. It will only be able to find luggage when another iPhone is nearby. The iPhone ecosystem is pretty good so it shouldn’t be much of a problem except in rural areas.

2\. You need to have an Apple product with an Apple ID to be able to use the AirTag. If you have a Samsung Galaxy Phone, try the [**Samsung Galaxy SmartTag**](https://amzn.to/3d1Ckb5). If you have another brand’s android phone, try [**Tile Mate**](https://amzn.to/3wECYmg). But be warned that while Tile products work great abroad they don’t work so well in India. This is so because, like Apple AirTags, the system relies on lost items coming in close contact with another Tile user to show up on a map. Since we don’t have enough Tile users in India, the system doesn’t work well enough.

[**Buy the Apple Airtag**](https://amzn.to/3xad5Ld) \| [**Buy the Airtag Keychain**](https://amzn.to/3wgjZ1d)

[GoTrippin Premium Universal Travel Adapter with 5 Year Warranty, Dual USB Charger Ports and Smart Charging (Black), International Worldwide Charger Plug for Phone, Laptop, Mobile, Camera, Tablet](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B07WDJR33C?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "GoTrippin Premium Universal Travel Adapter with 5 Year Warranty, Dual USB Charger Ports and Smart Charging (Black), International Worldwide Charger Plug for Phone, Laptop, Mobile, Camera, Tablet")

₹1,499.00

This is another one of those travel products that are so basic but so important to remember if you’re travelling abroad. Do not, we repeat, do not forget to carry a [**power adapter**](https://amzn.to/3WcoisR). There are at least 15 different types of electrical outlets in the world and you’d rather be prepared. Imagine not being able to charge your gadgets!

[**Buy an International Power Adaptor**](https://amzn.to/353tu88)

[Belkin 10000 mAh PD 3.0 Slim Fast Charging Power Bank with 1 USB-C and 2 USB-A Ports to Charge 3 Devices Simultaneously, for iPhones, Android Phones, Smart Watches & More – Black](https://www.amazon.in/dp/B092TN8FWV?tag=trywanderingm-21&linkCode=ogi&th=1&psc=1 "Belkin 10000 mAh PD 3.0 Slim Fast Charging Power Bank with 1 USB-C and 2 USB-A Ports to Charge 3 Devices Simultaneously, for iPhones, Android Phones, Smart Watches & More - Black")

₹3,499.00

We use our phones for everything these days – photos, videos, calling, message, social media, notes, editing and more – so obviously the battery runs out pretty quick. I know this one’s quite obvious, but just to re-iterate – carry a portable charger always so that your phone is always working and you never feel handicapped. This [**URBN power bank**](https://amzn.to/2TdN1QA) is an ultra-compact one (it is seriously very tiny) and weighs only 180 gm.

[**Buy the URBN Ultra Compact Power Bank**](https://amzn.to/2TdN1QA)

**[Buy this fingerprint lock](https://amzn.to/4dhMh11)**
